info.name: LegalHub Backend API (v1)
info.description:
Complete Postman v2.1 Collection for LegalHub (Pakistan Legal Marketplace). Compatible with Postman and Thunder Client.

### Usage:
1. Execute 'POST /auth/login' to authenticate.
2. The test script automatically captures the returned JWT and updates the {{token}} collection variable.
3. All subsequent protected requests use Bearer {{token}} automatically.

request.description: Public health check endpoint returning server operational status.
Registers a new citizen client account and automatically saves token.
Registers a new advocate account and automatically saves token.
Authenticates user credentials and automatically populates {{token}} variable.
Retrieves the authenticated user profile using Bearer token.
